t: What Groundwater Aquifer Database Is All About
title: What Groundwater Aquifer Database Is All About
description: Groundwater is the hidden reservoir: the Ogallala Aquifer waters a third of US irrigated agriculture but recharges at <1 inch/year while pumping draws feet — mining, not using. Aquifers need boundaries mapped, recharge estimated, and extraction metered. India's wells dropped water tables 30+ feet in places; managed recharge (spreading basins, injection) banks wet-year water. The rule: pump within recharge, or schedule the depletion honestly. This database is the complete aquifer record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
